name: The US legal market in numbers: headline findings from Probative's open datasets
description: Headline counts about the US legal market, each computed from one or more of Probative's open datasets and published as a quarterly edition: counties with no law office, Spanish speakers against Spanish-speaking lawyers, ad-rule waiting periods and filing duties, truck-crash deaths, workplace charges, the immigration court backlog, veterans' representation, deadlines to sue, legal-services prices, who earns the fees, mass-tort dockets, disability hearing waits, bankruptcy filings, nursing-home fines and unpaid wages. Every record gives the number, its denominator, one plain sentence in English and Spanish, what the number does not show, and the source dataset's version, DOI and record, so each figure can be traced and recomputed.
citeAs: Probative Growth. (2026). The US legal market in numbers: headline findings from Probative's open datasets (Version 1.1.0) [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23748830

distribution.name: findings.csv
distribution.description: Every record, one row each (RFC 4180, UTF-8). Columns are described in README.txt.

distribution.name: findings.json
distribution.description: Every record with its full sources, under a meta envelope (credit line, DOI, license).

recordSet.name: findings
recordSet.description: The records of The US legal market in numbers: headline findings from Probative's open datasets, one per CSV row.

field.name: id
field.description: Stable record id (never reused)

field.name: finding
field.description: The finding's number in this edition (F01, F02 ...); the report anchor is its lowercase form

field.name: edition
field.description: The quarterly edition, YYYY-Qn

field.name: topic
field.description: A short topic label

field.name: value
field.description: The headline number (see unit)

field.name: unit
field.description: What the value counts

field.name: denominator
field.description: The number the value is out of, or divided by (see denominatorLabel)

field.name: denominatorLabel
field.description: What the denominator counts

field.name: period
field.description: The period or date the source data covers

field.name: text
field.description: The record in one plain-English sentence

field.name: textEs
field.description: The same sentence in Spanish

field.name: limits
field.description: What the figure does not show

field.name: sourceDataset
field.description: The Probative dataset(s) it is computed from, separated by semicolons

field.name: sourceVersion
field.description: The version of each source dataset, in the same order

field.name: sourceDoi
field.description: The DOI of each source dataset version, in the same order (empty when not yet minted)

field.name: sourceRecord
field.description: The source record id(s), separated by semicolons

field.name: sourceRecordUrl
field.description: The data API file holding the first source record

field.name: anchor
field.description: The finding's link on the report page (the 'cite this figure' link)

field.name: ogImage
field.description: A 1200 x 630 share image of the finding

field.name: computed
field.description: The date the finding was computed

field.name: status
field.description: P primary source, S secondary source

field.name: lastChecked
field.description: The day it was last confirmed (YYYY-MM-DD)

field.name: confidence
field.description: high, medium or low: computed from status, a second check, age against the refresh cadence and sampling error (rule: /data/#confidence)

field.name: confidenceBasis
field.description: The reasons for the confidence level, in a short phrase
